challenge.headline: September Referral Sprint
challenge.reward: Refer 15 signups before October 1 and get 6 months of Butler free
challenge.description: Every new signup you refer this month counts toward the sprint. Reach 15 referred signups before the clock runs out and we hand you 6 months of Butler Pro, on the house. Climb the board below and claim your spot.
howItWorks: What counts: each new signup from your referral link or code.
The goal: 15 referred signups before the deadline.
The prize: 6 months of Butler Pro, free.
The clock: ends October 1, 11:59pm Mountain Time.
